description: Files that reach a model provider outside the governed AI gateway — by constructing an SDK client, calling a provider endpoint directly, or using a shared client factory's returned client. This is the gateway-bypass burndown list. Do NOT add to it: route new AI calls through server/services/ai-gateway (getGateway) or server/lib/unified-ai-client. Every entry carries a REASON stating what governance is lost; an entry without one fails the gate. Removing entries by routing them through the gateway is the point. Enforced by scripts/ci/check-gateway-bypass.mjs.

server/services/anthropic-client.ts.reason: Shared Anthropic client factory — the canonical place a raw client is constructed for callers that have not yet moved to the gateway. Kept as burndown, not blessed: baselining the CONSTRUCTOR is what let ungoverned CALLS through getAnthropicClient() spread to files nobody baselined, which is why this gate now matches the call sites too.

server/services/openai-client.ts.reason: Shared OpenAI client factory — same status and same caveat as anthropic-client.ts above.

server/services/ai/LiteLLMAdapter.ts.reason: WIDEST BYPASS. Posts to `${this.baseUrl}/chat/completions` — an OpenAI-compatible proxy — and server/services/aiProviderRouter.ts makes the gateway the ELSE branch: `if (this.liteLLMAdapter.isEnabled()) { ... } else { executeViaGateway(...) }`. One env flag (LITELLM_ENABLED) therefore diverts EVERY routed call away from policy evaluation, the PII/PHI fail-closed screen, the provider-placement/residency check and the ai.gateway_audit_log row; the router writes its own ai_provider_audit_log row with no prompt hash, resolved model or residency. .env.example defaults it false and nothing in helm/terraform/compose sets it, so this is latent rather than live — and nothing announces at boot that the gateway has been bypassed. UPDATE 2026-09-10 (WO-6): the silence is fixed, the bypass is not. Enabling the flag now logs an AI GATEWAY BYPASSED warning at construction in EVERY environment, and in production REFUSES TO BOOT unless LITELLM_UNGOVERNED_ACK is set to an exact acknowledgement string that names what is given up (mirroring server/db/rlsEnforcement.ts). Pinned by server/services/ai/__tests__/litellm-gateway-bypass-fail-closed.contract.test.ts. This entry STAYS: a guarded bypass is still a bypass, and it leaves the baseline only when LiteLLM runs as a provider INSIDE the gateway rather than as its else branch.

server/huggingface-service.ts.reason: HALF RESOLVED 2026-09-10 (WO-6). The TEXT-INFERENCE half is gone: queryHuggingFace now routes through aiComplete, and the ~390 lines of keyword-matching template generators it fell back to are deleted. Those generators were the more serious defect. All three failure branches — no API key, unparseable response, any thrown error — returned confident clinical guidance built from hardcoded strings ("Phase 3: 500-1500 participants", "Typically aim for 80-90% power"), with nothing in the returned text marking it as locally generated. It reached users: endpoint-recommender-service.ts:1035 is mounted via server/bootstrap/register-inline-routes.ts, and when its JSON parse fails it splits the response line by line and returns those lines as SUGGESTED CLINICAL TRIAL ENDPOINTS. A failure is now a thrown error. WHAT REMAINS BASELINED is generateEmbeddings, which still axios.posts to api-inference.huggingface.co. CORRECTION to this entry as it previously read: it claimed generateEmbeddings "bypasses embedding-corpus-policy.ts and its dimension-consistency guarantee". That overstates it, and the real finding is worse. Investigated 2026-09-10 against the live database: NOT ONE of the five callers writes the vector to a pgvector column. Four serialize it to JSON files in directories that do not exist; the fifth uses it as a query vector against academic_embeddings, a table declared only in a Drizzle literal (server/academic-knowledge-tracker.ts:30), created by no migration, written by no code, and typed json rather than vector even there. So there is no dimension collision to guarantee against — the path is dead on arrival, and CORPUS_POLICY covers none of its destinations. Two further findings recorded in WO-15: scripts/ci/check-embedding-runtime-canonicality.mjs is regex-bound to the OpenAI call shape and cannot see a HuggingFace embedding call at all; and embeddingService.embedForCorpus, which embedding-corpus-policy.ts:48 instructs runtime callers to use, does not exist — enhancedEmbeddingService.ts does not even import the policy it is documented as enforcing. This entry leaves the baseline when the dead embedding path is deleted, not when it is migrated: migrating a call whose result is thrown away would be work spent making dead code governed.

server/services/nanoBananaService.ts.reason: new GoogleGenerativeAI(GOOGLE_GEMINI_API_KEY); /generate and /edit are image generation, but the /chat and presentation paths are multi-turn text inference on gemini-2.0-flash. It also relaxes Google's harm thresholds to BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH with no compensating gateway policy pass. Mounted at /api/nano-banana.

server/services/rag-reranker.ts.reason: Cross-encoder rerankers at api.cohere.com/v2/rerank and api.voyageai.com/v1/rerank, shipping the user query plus up to 2000 characters of each retrieved document. Active only when RAG_RERANKER_PROVIDER + _API_KEY + _MODEL are all set, so latent by default; when active there is no audit row, no PII screen on retrieved corpus content, and tokensUsed is reported as 0 unconditionally so cost is structurally invisible.

server/services/anthropic-files.ts.reason: Anthropic Files API upload/delete, not inference. It is still content egress to a model provider that the gateway's PII/PHI screen never sees, and the uploaded file is later referenced by gateway-routed calls. Feature-flagged off by default. Recorded as a bypass of the content-screening layer rather than of model-call audit.

server/routes/integration-test.ts.reason: NOT INFERENCE. Fetches https://api.openai.com/v1/models purely as a reachability probe (the code says so: 'don't burn tokens'), and the router is mounted only under testRoutesEnabled, so it is fenced out of production. Baselined rather than path-excluded because it IS egress to a provider host and should stay visible if that mount fence ever moves.

server/services/semanticSearch.js.reason: DEAD CODE. axios.post to api.openai.com/v1/embeddings, but its only importers (server/pipelines/bulk_import.js, indexDocs.js) are themselves recorded as unreferenced modules, and its DB target is a logged no-op since the Phase 2 retrieval convergence. Kept visible because it is still on the embedding-runtime APPROVED list; deleting the file resolves both.

server/services/huggingface-service.js.reason: DEAD CODE. axios.post to api-inference.huggingface.co (Llama-2-70b). Zero importers; recorded in unreferenced-modules-baseline.json. Superseded by the .ts service of the same name.

server/services/csr-extractor-service.ts.reason: DEAD CODE. getOpenAIClient().chat.completions.create with gpt-4-turbo-preview, reachable only through a barrel chain (services/csr/index.ts ← services/index.ts) that is itself recorded as unreferenced; the exported csrExtractorService symbol has zero call sites.
